scripts.build: next build && node -e "if (!process.env.NEXT_ON_PAGES) { process.env.NEXT_ON_PAGES = \"1\"; try { require(\"child_process\").execSync(\"npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages@1.13.16\", { stdio: \"inherit\" }); require(\"fs\").writeFileSync(\".vercel/output/static/.assetsignore\", \"_worker.js\\n\"); } catch (e) { if (process.platform === \"win32\") { console.warn(\"Warning: @cloudflare/next-on-pages failed on Windows, skipping...\", e.message); } else { throw e; } } }"
scripts.test:logic: ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" tests/course_completion.test.ts && ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" tests/enrollment_duplicate.test.ts && ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" tests/time_utilities.test.ts && ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" tests/session_guard.test.ts && ts-node --compiler-options "{\"module\":\"CommonJS\"}" tests/billing_validation.test.ts
scripts.lock:sync: npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit && (npx --yes pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --lockfile-only 2>/dev/null || echo 'pnpm skipped')
scripts.build:force: npm run lock:sync && npm run build
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx wrangler versions upload --env preview --preview-alias preview
scripts.deploy:version: npm run build && npx wrangler versions upload
scripts.versions:promote: npx wrangler versions upload && npx wrangler versions deploy --yes 100
scripts.deploy:quick: npm run build && npx wrangler versions upload && npx wrangler versions deploy --yes 100
scripts.workflow:instances: npx wrangler workflows instances list lesson-transcription-workflow
